Rift 0.11.2 fixes white window border artifacts on Windows 10 introduced by the composition mode change in 0.11.1.

## Download

- **`Rift-win-Setup.exe`**: installs Rift for your user (no admin rights, no .NET needed). Already have 0.9–0.11.1? It updates itself.
- **`Rift-win-Portable.zip`**: runs from any folder, no install, and updates itself too.

The exe isn't signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn on the first start: "More info" → "Run anyway".

## Fixed in 0.11.2

- Fixed white non-client border artifacts around the window on Windows 10 under `Win32CompositionMode.RedirectionSurface` by keeping DWM non-client frame rendering (`DWMNCRP_ENABLED`) and dark/light border attributes (`DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE`) active across frame updates, window state transitions, and theme changes
- Enabled `OverlayPopups` on Windows so Avalonia tooltips, context menus, and address bar dropdowns render inside the GPU window scene with transparent rounded shadows

See [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/keyldev/rift/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) for what's next.
